title: Maria and Her Cards
text:
Maria has many flashcards. Each card has a word on one side. On the other side, there is a picture. Maria studies with her cards every day.

Today she learns the word dog. The card has a picture of a dog. Maria says the word again and again. Then she smiles.

questions.text: What is on one side of each card?
What word does Maria learn today?
Why does Maria study with her cards every day?
options: She wants to learn new words
She wants to go to sleep
She wants to buy a car

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel at the end?

vocabulary.definition: a small piece of stiff paper with information on it
shows a happy face with the mouth turned up

paragraph_translations: Maria'nın birçok kartı var. Her kartın bir yüzünde bir kelime var. Diğer yüzünde bir resim var. Maria her gün kartlarıyla çalışır.
Bugün dog (köpek) kelimesini öğreniyor. Kartta bir köpeğin resmi var. Maria kelimeyi tekrar tekrar söyler. Sonra gülümser.
